title: First-page cycles and boundaries of a filtered complex
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], $K$ a cochain complex indexed by $\mathbb Z$, and $F$ a decreasing filtration by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration]. For every $p,n\in\mathbb Z$, the subobjects [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients] satisfy $\mathrm{complexCycles}(p,n,1)=\ker(\mathrm{gr}^pK^n\to\mathrm{gr}^pK^{n+1})$ and $\mathrm{complexBoundaries}(p,n,1)=\operatorname{im}(\mathrm{gr}^pK^{n-1}\to\mathrm{gr}^pK^n)$. No finiteness assumption is required.

source.place: Tag 012K, displayed cycle-boundary formulas and Lemma 12.24.2 (current numbering); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/012K

proof.text: Write m_n for the inclusion F^pK^n → K^n, l_n for the inclusion F^{p+1}K^n → F^pK^n and q_n for the graded projection. Evaluation of the cokernel sequence of complexes is a cokernel sequence, so q_n is epic and its kernel is image l_n. The graded differential δ satisfies q_n ≫ δ = d_p ≫ q_{n+1}, where d_p is the differential restricted to F^p. Pulling back ker δ along q_n therefore gives the inverse image under d_p of image l_{n+1}. Under the mono m_n this is precisely F^pK^n ∩ d⁻¹(F^{p+1}K^{n+1}). It contains F^{p+1}K^n since the steps are subcomplexes, so the extra sum in complexCycles is redundant. The image under an epimorphism of the pullback of a subobject is that subobject. Applying this to ker δ proves the cycle formula.

source.place: Tag 012K, displayed cycle-boundary formulas and Lemma 12.24.2 (current numbering); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/012K

proof.text: For boundaries, q_{n-1} is epic, hence image δ = image(q_{n-1} ≫ δ) = image(d_p ≫ q_n). Under m_n, image d_p is d(F^pK^{n-1}), which is contained in F^pK^n by the subcomplex condition; thus the intersection in complexBoundaries at r=1 is redundant. Pullback along the mono m_n recovers image d_p. Adding the subobject F^{p+1} before applying q_n has no effect on its image, since q_n kills that subobject. The resulting image is exactly image(d_p ≫ q_n) = image δ.

lean.statement:
theorem filteredComplex_firstPage_cycles_boundaries (F : DecreasingFiltration K) :
    ∀ p n : ℤ,
      F.complexCycles p n 1 = kernelSubobject ((F.gradedPiece p).d n (n + 1)) ∧
      F.complexBoundaries p n 1 = imageSubobject ((F.gradedPiece p).d (n - 1) n)
